method.ABSORB: delivery share up >=20% vs prior 40 sessions while 10-day range <=9% and price within 15% of its 60-day high
method.SHAKE: a >=3% fall on >=2x volume, then >=3 quiet sessions (<=70% volume, delivery held) without a new low
method.HHHL: last two swing lows and last two swing highs both rising, volume contracting
method.FIBDRY: >=40% leg, price within 3% of a 38.2/50/61.8/78.6% level and 5-day volume <=40% of peak-time volume
method.SURGEQ: >=3% up on >=2x volume with delivery share >=1.2x its 40-session norm
method.SURGEHOLD: a SURGEQ day 3-10 sessions ago that has held with volume <=60% of that day and no lower low
method.RUNLOWDEL: >=20% in 10 sessions with delivery share <=70% of norm (retail-heavy run, high risk)
method.CLIMAX: exit watch: after >=20% in 10 sessions, >=2.5x volume and close in the lower third of the range
method.REDHEAVY: exit watch: after >=20% in 10 sessions, a red candle on >=2x volume
method.liquidity: price >= 40 and 20-day average traded value >= 3 crore
